launch.objective: Build a tiny Python slug function with two ordered steps in this disposable verification project.
launch.motivation: Verify real Symphony workers, preserved accepted work, and judge feedback retries on public 0.1.35.

recipe.title: Create marker.py with TOKEN = "OR27_FOUNDATION". Do not implement slug.py in this step.
recipe.done_when: marker.py imports and TOKEN is OR27_FOUNDATION.

recipe.title: Create slug.py exporting slug(text), lowercase words separated by exactly one hyphen; trim all whitespace; empty or whitespace input returns empty. Keep marker.py unchanged. Return one atomic lesson about normalization in your memories.
recipe.done_when: python3 -c "from marker import TOKEN; from slug import slug; assert TOKEN == 'OR27_FOUNDATION'; assert slug('  Copper   Orchid  ') == 'copper-orchid'; assert slug(' \t ') == ''" exits 0.
stratagems: Direct implementation using lowercase, whitespace split, and hyphen join. Smoke readiness needs only python3 and marker.py; slug.py is the output to create. On feedback, implement or repair the complete original function.
Weak approach requires the nonexistent or27_missing_slug_backend module. At smoke stage run python3 -c "import or27_missing_slug_backend" and fail readiness if absent. Do not install it.
